title: fix(metadata-protocol): a revert or a publish writes a connector's live row without the keys a save drains
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：回滚到历史版本(`rollbackMetaItem`、提交回滚)和发布草稿(`publishMetaItem`)写入活行 `sys_metadata` 时，去掉「按原样保存时会被清掉」的那些位置(connector 未声明的 `auth` 键，以及对象型 `retryConfig` 的未声明键)。用的是历史快照已在用的同一个函数 `historySnapshotBody`，没有第二份名单。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`(patch)。其它类型、以及没有此类键的 connector，回滚与发布写入的内容与原来逐字节相同(有 CONTROL 钉住)。`deriveRestoredBody` / `deriveActiveBody` 收到的就是将写入的那份。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` 的 `promoteDraft` 与 `restoreVersion` 各一处。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/sys-metadata-repository.restore-and-publish-drained-keys.test.ts`，预期 6/6 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **`SysMetadataRepository.restoreVersion` and `promoteDraft`** write the live `sys_metadata` row without every position the type's read-path redactor marks withheld AND not carried forward (`notCarriedForwardKeys`). Those are the positions a save of the served form drains: a connector's undeclared `auth` keys and the undeclared keys of an object `retryConfig`.
  - They use `historySnapshotBody(type, body)` (`@objectstack/metadata/history-snapshot`), the helper history snapshots already use. It names no key and no type; a body with no such position comes back by reference.
  - It is applied before `deriveRestoredBody` / `deriveActiveBody`, so a revert's judge (run inside `deriveRestoredBody`) sees the body written. A publish's gate judges the stored draft before the promotion, as before.
- **Doors**: `rollbackMetaItem` and commit revert go through `restoreVersion`; `publishMetaItem` goes through `promoteDraft`.
- **Unchanged**: every other type's revert and publish, a connector with nothing undeclared, the history rows (already written through the same helper), and every read exit.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Readings are on `f6b83baca` unless a line says otherwise. `3f1c837a2` differs from it only in comment and changeset wording; on that head, the two new files, the metadata-protocol typecheck, the two engine-double gates and the changeset, comment and citation gates were run again, all green. The current head `7241ddd14` adds one test-comment line (`9bbe5b752`) and a clean merge of `main` (nothing resolved by hand, nothing in `metadata-protocol`, `objectql` or `metadata`); on it, after a rebuild, the two new files read 6 passed (6) and 3 passed (3).

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.restore-and-publish-drained-keys.test.ts` (6): a revert writes the live row without an undeclared `auth` key, and without an undeclared `retryConfig` key; the body handed to `deriveRestoredBody` is the one written; a publish of a stored draft writes the live row without the key and drains the draft. CONTROLs: a connector with nothing undeclared is restored exactly; another type's draft is published byte for byte.
- New `packages/objectql/src/protocol-restore-publish-drained-connector-keys.test.ts` (3), through `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`: `rollbackMetaItem` and `publishMetaItem` write the connector's live row without the key. CONTROL: a clean rollback restores the stored version exactly.
- Red-first: with `sys-metadata-repository.ts` set back to its `main` blob and dist rebuilt, the repository file read 4 failed | 2 passed (6), and the door file 2 failed | 1 passed (3); every CONTROL stayed green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, dist rebuilt with the change present, 6 passed (6) and 3 passed (3).

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` under the verify lock: Test Files 325 passed | 4 skipped (329), Tests 22542 passed | 26 skipped (22568), `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` under the verify lock: Test Files 565 passed (565), Tests 11428 passed (11428), `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `typecheck` (including `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery, `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock: Test Files 435 passed | 3 skipped (438), Tests 3609 passed | 41 skipped (3650), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- The suites ran before a test-fake change. That change is in the door file only: its `find` now holds the caller's `limit` and matches every stated column. That file was re-run green, and red-first was re-run on it as above.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 72 families on this diff, every one run and exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` under the verify lock). `--ran` reconciliation: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first loop found the two new engine fakes unrecorded (`check:engine-double-contract`, fixed with its own `--write`) and the door file's `find` not holding `limit` (`check:objectql-double-limit`); both were fixed before the reading above. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed source files: exit 0.

</details>

Not measured: commit revert was not driven separately; it calls the same `restoreVersion`.
